title: Workspace Insights request triage and enterprise reporting playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an operational playbook for intake, triage and prioritization of workspace-level reporting and enterprise analytics requests that arrive via Support, CSMs, Sales, and self-serve forms. The goal is to provide consistent SLAs and clear routing to owners (PM/Eng/Analytics/Design) and to produce a prioritized backlog that balances business value, regulatory needs, and engineering cost. Playbook will standardize: intake channels and required fields, initial triage rubric (impact, frequency, revenue, compliance, engineering cost), staging (quick wins vs. scoped projects), expected response timelines, template PRD or request forms, and escalation paths for enterprise contracts that require SLAs or custom exports.
acceptance_criteria: Published intake form and internal triage rubric in Confluence with versioned examples
Automated routing rules configured for Support/CSM requests that tag 'enterprise-reporting' and assign to PM queue
Prioritization matrix documented and adopted by PMs with 2 pilot triages completed
Five representative requests (exports/dashboards/cost breakdown) processed end-to-end using the playbook and labeled in Linear
Handoff checklist for ENG/Analytics that includes data contracts, privacy notes, and test scenarios
notes: We need to avoid duplicating existing ad-hoc dashboard work; focus on repeatable export patterns (scheduled CSV/S3 exports, per-customer cost breakdowns, audit logs)
Consider short-term 'lite' deliverables (templated exports + CLI) vs. long-term dashboarding features in Console
Trade-offs: heavy customization per customer increases maintenance; recommend configurable templates first
Coordinate with Legal for data residency requirements for customers in EU/APAC before prioritizing on-prem exports
